answer: Like a sonnet that only rhymes when every line is true, each identity must bind one distinct verified bank account, confirmed by a micro-deposit only its owner can report back. Opening a real account needs KYC, so a farm would need dozens of genuine accounts, each with its own paper trail; accounts sharing one holder collapse to a single voice, and the vine of shared funding withers. One account, one voice, rooted like a knoll that cannot be copied.
